title: Evidence
description: DESIGN-level schema. Represents an Evidence record per architecture/evidence/EVIDENCE_MODEL.md. The evidence/ directory must remain empty of fabricated results; this schema defines the structure for future real evidence artifacts.

evidenceId.description: Unique identifier for this evidence record.

claim.description: The specific claim this evidence supports or refutes.

maturity.description: Maturity Status this evidence substantiates, per architecture/evidence/EVIDENCE_MODEL.md.

method.description: Description of how the evidence was produced (test procedure, measurement method, review process).

result.description: Outcome data. No fabricated or placeholder values permitted; omit until real results exist.

producedBy.description: Identifier of the actor, test harness, or process that produced this evidence.

relatedArtifacts.description: Repository-relative links to related requirement, design, implementation, or test artifacts.
